title: Watchouts
slide_intent: Teach designers to recognize alterations that make a signature harder to read or identify. Comparing each treatment against the same mark isolates what has changed.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can preserve the close relationship between its name and the striding figure even when different partners reproduce them.
demonstration: Nine crossed examples change the lockup, outline, color, proportions, effects or relationship to a photograph or added text.
practical_value: Check a finished layout for added effects, competing imagery and unauthorized changes to the supplied lockup.

content_islands.name: Navigation and caution
content_islands.spec: Mark Watchouts in the Our logo chapter of the left rail. Place the short caution beside it and leave the remainder of the page for comparisons.

content_islands.name: Misuse grid
content_islands.spec: Arrange nine examples in three columns. Place a pink cross and a brief diagnosis beneath each mark so that the reader can locate the exact change.

content_islands.name: Image treatments
content_islands.spec: Use the last row to distinguish attached event text, a busy image behind the logo and photography filling the letterforms.
